---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever building or editing any page, component or copy for the Apex Detail Studio website in Lahore.
---

1. Brand: The business is "Apex Detail Studio", based in Lahore, Pakistan. Always write the full name on first mention in any page; "Apex" alone is fine afterwards.
2. Tagline: Use "Perfection, Polished." beneath the logo in the header and footer, and as the homepage hero headline.
3. Tone: Confident, calm and precise, like a premium automotive brand. Short sentences. No slang, no exclamation marks, no emojis, no discount-style language.
4. Colours: Background `#0A0A0B`, surface `#141416`, primary text `#F5F5F2`, muted text `#9A9A9F`, accent gold `#C8A25E`, hairline borders `#2A2A2E`. Use gold sparingly for buttons, links and key highlights only.
5. Fonts: Headings in "Playfair Display" (serif, weights 500-700). Body and UI in "Inter" (weights 400-500). Set headings with generous letter-spacing and large sizes; keep body text at 16px minimum.
6. Every page must include: a sticky dark header with logo and navigation, one clear primary call-to-action ("Book a Consultation"), a footer with address, phone, WhatsApp link and opening hours, and a mobile-friendly layout that works at 375px width.
7. Services: Group services into three categories: Exterior, Interior and Protection. Each service card needs a short description and a starting price.
8. Prices: Always write in PKR with a space and comma separators, for example "PKR 25,000". Use "from PKR 45,000" for starting prices. Never use symbols like Rs or $.
9. Dates and numbers: Write dates as "23 November 2026". Use 24-hour times only in booking forms; elsewhere use "10:00 am". Use Pakistan phone format "+92 300 1234567".
10. Never: Never use stock-photo clichés, bright or light backgrounds, or fabricated reviews, awards or customer names. Use photography placeholders clearly marked for replacement.
